title: Start Journaling
coreMove: Put the mind on paper before it hardens into a script; a private sentence can be checked, crossed out, thanked, or changed.

exampleSpecs.audience: Fabrice, a release lead writing after a strained incident call
exampleSpecs.stakes: A private note can become blame before the team has the facts.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Fabrice notices his own blaming sentence mid-stream and catches the error before sending the incident summary.

exampleSpecs.audience: Wallace, an education coordinator deciding how to frame a student writing exercise
exampleSpecs.stakes: Students may treat journaling as performance unless the assignment protects honest private attention.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A memo carries the scene by showing Wallace choose privacy over display after studying Anne Frank's diary in Amsterdam.

exampleSpecs.audience: Tristan and Chiara, two coordinators facing the same recurring missed handoff
exampleSpecs.stakes: Memory may excuse a pattern that written records would reveal.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Two named people face the same missed handoff, one trusts memory and one checks a journal, with different outcomes.

exampleSpecs.audience: Bao, a junior designer stuck after a harsh critique
exampleSpecs.stakes: An angry story may harden into identity before the next revision.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A mentor reframes Bao's stuck view in one conversation and gives a quotable line about naming heat.

exampleSpecs.audience: Zuri, a teacher guiding students through a diary-based lesson
exampleSpecs.stakes: A student may mistake journaling for neat moral summaries instead of honest observation.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The learner's confusion becomes the material of the lesson, grounded in Anne Frank's diary in Amsterdam.

exampleSpecs.audience: Bashir, an emergency operations chief reviewing his own leadership log
exampleSpecs.stakes: The same log can either defend an ego or train steadier public judgment.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Bashir before and after changing how he writes, with Meditations as the model of private self-instruction.
